page_title: PAR 2-1 ACM | Parma v AC Milan 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Parma was in an offside position.
90+4' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) takes a short corner kick.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Juan Luca Sacchi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
88' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) has tested the patience of referee Juan Luca Sacchi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
86' Paulo Fonseca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luka Jovic (AC Milan) replacing Noah Okafor.
86' The substitution is prepared. Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Christian Pulisic.
85' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
84' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:16.
84' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
82' Half-chance! Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) plays a pass into the box, but Zion Suzuki reacts well to snuff out the attack.
80' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
77' 2 - 1 Goal! Pontus Almqvist tees up Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 2:1.
74' Substitution. Pontus Almqvist (Parma) replaces Dennis Man.
74' Nahuel Estevez is being substituted because of an injury. Fabio Pecchia sends Wylan Cyprien (Parma) on the pitch.
74' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
73' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
70' Substitution. Valentin Mihaila will be replaced by Enrico Del Prato (Parma).
69' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
68' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
67' Here is a change. Davide Calabria is going off and Paulo Fonseca gives the last tactical orders to Emerson Royal (AC Milan).
67' We are about to witness a substitution. Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) is replacing Yunus Musah.
66' 1 - 1 Goal! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Rafael Leao. The score is 1:1.
65' AC Milan enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
62' What a big chance! Dennis Man (Parma) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
61' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
61' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) makes a slide tackle, but referee Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul.
60' A goal, which was scored by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma), was disallowed due to offside.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) replaces Simon Sohm.
57' Close! Noah Okafor (AC Milan) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
56' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
54' Ball possession – 41:59.
50' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
50' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the left post is saved by Zion Suzuki.
49' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) receives the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort, but it goes well over the top.
48' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
48' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post.
47' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) gets into a shooting position! What a long-range cannonball of a shot! His nice effort, however, only crashes against the crossbar. Aim better, sir.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Mike Maignan.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and it's Valentin Mihaila (Parma) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
44' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
42' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
42' Simon Sohm (Parma) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
37' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan), but it's just wide of the right post.
37' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
36' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, AC Milan are going to take it.
36' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Rafael Leao (AC Milan), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
34' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi had an easy-decision to make.
34' A lofted cross from Davide Calabria (AC Milan) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
32' AC Milan failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
32' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
31' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
31' AC Milan work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
31' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the roof of the net, but Zion Suzuki is alert and denies him.
30' AC Milan take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
30' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Zion Suzuki anticipates well and smothers the ball.
29' Juan Luca Sacchi couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Yunus Musah (AC Milan) and blew his whistle.
27' Great teamplay by AC Milan as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
24' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
22' AC Milan fail to score from a corner as Zion Suzuki (Parma) leaps to collect the ball.

22' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
21' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley well wide of the right post.
20' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) will deliver the corner kick.
17' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
17' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
15' Woyo Coulibaly (Parma) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
14' Parma are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
13' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
13' Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul after Davide Calabria (AC Milan) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
11' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Dennis Man (Parma).
10' Dennis Man (Parma) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The linesman makes the right call and Parma will have a corner.
10' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Zion Suzuki, who smothers the ball.
7' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
6' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
6' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
5' The referee blows his whistle as Rafael Leao (AC Milan) was too aggressive in his challenge.
3' Juan Luca Sacchi sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
3' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Parma players aren’t happy.
2' 1 - 0 Goal! Dennis Man (Parma) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Emanuele Valeri inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
1' Alessandro Circati (Parma) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Parma will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Juan Luca Sacchi.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
